title: Paul's Greeting and Epaphras' Service in Colossae
description: Paul and Timothy greet the saints in Colossae with grace and peace from God. They thank God for the church's faith in Christ Jesus and their love for all the saints, motivated by the hope stored up for them in heaven. The gospel is bearing fruit and growing among them just as it does throughout the world. It was Epaphras, Paul's dear fellow servant and a faithful minister of Christ, who first preached the message to the Colossians and has told Paul about their love in the Spirit.
